data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 553.885m. The Syndicate recorded a prior-period release (net) of GBP 52.922m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end, driven by favourable development of prior year reserves, a low level of catastrophe activity in 2015 and disciplined claims selection and management. Most business units (Casualty, Professional, Marine and Aviation) benefited from prior year reserve improvements; Property and Commercial did not benefit. The reported figure available in the accounts is a net release; no explicit gross prior-year movement was presented in a dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column, so the reported net release has been used as the quantified prior-year movement.

data.data_quality_notes: The accounts explicitly state a net release of GBP 52,922k in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (page 39). No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was presented in a dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column that could be unambiguously extracted. The Technical Provisions reconciliation shows overall gross movement (which includes current year movement) but rules disallow using that line for prior-year development; a gross PYD-calculation from the claims development triangle was considered but the triangle as printed is partially ambiguous in the available OCR text. Therefore the disclosed NET release (GBP 52.922k) has been used as a last-resort quantified prior-year movement (flagged here). Users should note this is NET of reinsurance (not the preferred gross figure).
